Call log:

diagnosis.root_cause: The selector `text, [contenteditable="true"], .text-element, [class*="text"]` is too broad and matched a container `<div>` element (with class `text-dark-100`) instead of an actual input/editable element. The `.fill()` method only works on <input>, <textarea>, <select>, or [contenteditable] elements, not regular divs.
diagnosis.fix_suggestion: 1. Remove `[class*="text"]` from the selector as it incorrectly matches elements with utility classes like 'text-dark-100'. 2. Use a more specific selector like `page.locator('input[type="text"], input:not([type]), textarea, [contenteditable="true"]')` or `page.getByRole('textbox')`. 3. Alternatively, if the element is a contenteditable div, ensure it has `contenteditable="true"` attribute before calling fill, or use `.click()` followed by `page.keyboard.type()` for elements that require keyboard input simulation.
